On the day I felt the most desperate in the crypto world, my account had only 387 USDT.

That day was at three in the morning, a 15-minute big red candle for ETH shattered all my confidence.

I was right about the trend, and the logic was sound, but I still got shaken out—just after I set my stop-loss, the price rebounded instantly.

If you've been in the crypto world, you definitely understand how painful this feeling is.

The day before, I was still analyzing trends in the group, discussing structure, logic, and emotions;

The next day, I was staring blankly at my account, not even having the courage to continue placing orders.

What tormented me the most was not losing money,

but the doubt that started to creep in:

"Am I just not suited for this market?"

In those few days, I did three things:

First, I stopped trading;

Second, I cleared all positions;

Third, I started reviewing every trade I had made over the past year.

The results were harsh:

Almost all of my big losses were not due to being wrong about the direction,

but rather losing to emotions, position sizing, and frequent trading.

Later, I slowly changed:

I no longer traded every day, no longer went all in,

I extended my trading cycles, reduced my position sizes, and wrote down rules before placing orders.

Three months later, I hadn’t become rich,

but my account began to steadily rise for the first time.

Until one day I understood:

The crypto world never rewards the smartest people,

but rather rewards those who can survive.

Now looking back at that 387 USDT,

it has actually become the most valuable tuition I’ve paid in the crypto world.

If you are also at a low point right now,

remember this: 

Market opportunities may be missed, but as long as you are still here, opportunities will not be absent.

我在币圈最绝望的那一天，账户只剩 387 USDT。

那天是凌晨三点，ETH 一根 15 分钟大阴线，把我所有的自信一起砸碎。

趋势我是看对的，逻辑也没问题，但我还是被洗下车了——止损刚打完，价格原地反弹。

如果你在币圈待过，就一定懂这种感觉有多难受。

前一天我还在群里分析走势，讲结构、讲逻辑、讲情绪；

第二天，我却盯着账户发呆，连继续下单的勇气都没有。

最折磨人的不是亏钱，

而是你开始怀疑：

“是不是我根本不适合这个市场？”

那几天我做了三件事：

第一，停止交易；

第二，清空所有仓位；

第三，开始复盘自己过去一年的每一笔交易。

结果很残酷：

我几乎所有的大亏，都不是方向错，

而是输在情绪、仓位和频繁操作。

后来我慢慢改变：

不再天天交易，不再重仓梭哈，

周期拉长，仓位减半，规则写在下单前。

三个月后，我没有暴富，

但账户第一次稳定地往上走。

直到有一天我明白：

币圈从来不是奖励最聪明的人，

而是奖励能活下来的人。

现在回头看那 387 USDT，

它反而成了我在币圈交过最值的一笔学费。

如果你现在也在低谷，

记住一句话：

行情会错过，但只要你还在，机会就不会缺席。

title: Китовая ротация из BTC в ETH: что на самом деле означает обмен на $178 млн для рынка
subTitle:
Крупный держатель продал биткоин на сумму около $178 млн и на те же деньги купил 58 419 $ETH . На уровне заголовка это выглядит как громкий сигнал: “деньги перетекают из биткоина в эфир”. Но по сути это один из классических примеров ротации капитала, когда крупные игроки перераспределяют риск между активами, а не «уходят» из крипторынка. Важнее не сам факт сделки, а контекст — почему именно сейчас часть капитала выбирает ETH вместо BTC.
Обычно подобные переходы происходят в моменты, когда биткоин уже отыграл роль “локомотива” и рынок начинает искать следующую историю роста. Для части игроков эфир становится ставкой на более широкую экосистему: активность в смарт-контрактах, спрос на операции в сети, использование ETH как базового залога в разных стратегиях. Плюс работает и чистая математика портфеля: если $BTC  резко вырос раньше, фиксация части прибыли и перевод в ETH — способ сохранить экспозицию к рынку, но поменять профиль потенциальной доходности.

Однако вывод “деньги массово уходят из биткоина в эфир” делать рано. Одна крупная сделка — это не тренд, а точка данных. Киты часто действуют через набор связанных операций: балансируют позиции, закрывают кредитное плечо, перекладывают залоги, готовятся к новым входам. Иногда это может быть даже не «бычья ставка на ETH», а техническая перестановка капитала под конкретные стратегии: хеджирование, арбитраж, подготовка к волатильности или смена структуры риска.
Что это означает для рынка в целом? Такие сделки повышают внимание к ETH и часто подогревают разговор о “сезоне альткоинов”, но одновременно усиливают вероятность резких движений в обе стороны. В моменты ротации ликвидность может быстро перетекать между активами, создавая импульсы, которые выглядят как новый тренд — пока не появится подтверждение в виде серии подобных действий и устойчивого изменения спроса. Поэтому это скорее сигнал о смене предпочтений части крупного капитала, чем окончательный вердикт “капитал ушёл из BTC”.

从浮亏百万到爆赚！我的“逆天”空单布局，让所有多头闭嘴！

近期在日本加息消息影响下，BTC最近跌破9万美元，一度触及87000附近。之前我预判反弹能到95000-97000，实际只冲到94500。流动性收紧的环境下，反弹确实比想象中弱，滚仓操作也没做成。

接下来我的打算很明确：
如果价格回到95000-97000区间，我会考虑滚仓加空，不到就耐心等。

日本加息的短期利空已经落地，多头可能还会挣扎，但反弹空间我不太看好。

只要没有突发的大利空，80000这个位置支撑很强，直接跌破的可能性不大。

假如明年一季度真的跌破80000、进入主跌阶段，我会在70000左右分批平空，等月线级别出现反弹信号再重新布局空单。
目前行情在80000-94000之间震荡，我选择观望。

总的来说，我的策略就两句话：过95000就滚动加空，破80000就逐步平空。

说说我这大半年的建仓过程，确实不容易。我从周线顶背离、牛熊周期规律，以及对宏观环境的谨慎判断出发，才开始布局空单。这笔单子我已经拿了超过半年。

今年6月，我从9万多开始试探建仓，后来加仓到12万以上，之后又在10万上方每天定投加空。那时候市场情绪一片狂热，到处都在喊多，15万、20万的声音不绝于耳。

我一边承受着现货踏空的心理压力，一边看着长线空单持续浮亏，最终把币安的空单平均成本控制在了108000附近。OK和Gate上的仓位是后来补的，成本在12万上方，不过仓位轻，对整体影响不大。ETH的空单布局稍晚，各平台成本都在4600以上。

🔥Deep Dive into the Security Cornerstone of Ethereum: Why is Staking the "Anchor of Trust" for the Network?

Are you curious about what safeguards the security of this trillion-dollar network when Ethereum transitions to Proof of Stake (PoS)? The core of the answer lies in "staking." This is not only a way to earn rewards but also the economic cornerstone that the entire network relies on for stable operation.

⭐️Staking builds an unbreakable economic defense line
Under the PoS mechanism, validators need to stake ETH to qualify for maintaining the network. This creates a sophisticated economic security model: honest validators receive rewards, while malicious actions face the risk of having their staked assets confiscated. Therefore, the over 40 million staked ETH across the network constitutes a massive "security margin" pool, making the cost of attacking the network prohibitively high.

⭐️Staking connects a decentralized trust network
More importantly, millions of independent validators worldwide bind their interests to the long-term healthy development of the network through staking. This forms a powerful decentralized trust network that jointly defends the security and neutrality of the network from both physical and game-theoretic perspectives.

In summary, the staking mechanism is transforming Ethereum into a more energy-efficient, secure, and solid infrastructure capable of supporting global value. Every stake contributes to this shared trust.

🔥深挖以太坊安全基石：为何说质押是网络的“信任之锚”？

你是否好奇，当以太坊转向权益证明（PoS）后，是什么在守护着这个千亿级网络的安全？答案的核心，就在于“质押”。这不仅是获得收益的方式，更是整个网络赖以稳健运行的经济基石。

⭐️质押，构建了坚不可摧的经济防线
在PoS机制下，验证者需要质押ETH来获得维护网络的资格。这形成了一个精妙的经济安全模型：诚实验证获得奖励，恶意行为则会面临质押资产被罚没的风险。因此，全网超过4000万枚的质押ETH，构成了一个庞大的“安全保证金”池，使得攻击网络的成本高昂到不切实际。

⭐️质押，连接起去中心化的信任网络
更重要的是，全球数百万独立验证者通过质押，将自己的利益与网络的长期健康发展深度绑定。这形成了一个强大的去中心化信任网络，从物理和博弈层面共同捍卫网络的安全与中立。

总而言之，质押机制正在将以太坊打造成一个更节能、更安全、且能够承载全球价值的坚实基础设施。每一份质押，都在为这份共同的信任添砖加瓦。

title: 太牛了！遵循这三条规矩，1500U 轻松实现 5 万 U 逆袭，稳赚不赔！
subTitle:
去年有个粉丝揣着1500U来找我，说想靠这钱翻身回本。我没跟他扯那些花里胡哨的指标，直接甩给他三条我用血泪换来的铁律。他照着做了三个月，账户直接飙到5万U，一次都没爆过仓。这三条“保命规矩”，你能领悟多少，全看你对市场有没有敬畏心。
第一，资金分三份：先保命，再赚钱
我让他把1500U拆成三个500U，死死攥在手里——这是我当年全仓梭哈爆仓后，半夜盯着天花板悟出来的道理：
第一份钱只玩短线，每天最多开两单，做完就关软件。多看一眼都可能手贱，贪心就是爆仓的起点；第二份钱等趋势，周线没走出多头形态、没放量突破关键位，绝对不动。震荡行情里瞎折腾，等于给市场送钱；第三份钱是救命钱，行情突然插针要爆仓时，拿它补保证金。爆仓最多断根手指，本金亏光就是砍头——没本金，市场再好的机会都跟你没关系。
第二，只啃趋势的肉，其他时候当缩头乌龟
我早年在震荡行情里被割得遍体鳞伤，十次操作九次亏。后来我只认三个信号：
日线均线没形成多头排列，直接空仓。别怕“错过”，市场永远有机会；行情放量突破前高，且日线收盘能站稳，才小仓位试水；盈利达到本金30%，先提一半利润，剩下的设10%移动止盈。到嘴的肉才是自己的，别想着吃完整个行情——你吃不下。
第三，情绪锁死，执行像AI
开盘前必须写好计划，然后像机器一样执行：
止损死死定在3%，到了就割，绝不“再等等”。等一秒都可能万劫不复；盈利超过10%，立刻把止损拉到成本价。后面赚的全是市场送的红包，稳赚不赔；每天半夜12点准时关电脑，再诱人的K线也不看。睡不着就把APP删了——盯得越久，情绪越乱，一乱就错。
这三条规矩，说白了就是“先活下来，再想赚钱”。市场不是赌场，是绞肉机。你敬畏它，它才可能给你口饭吃；你跟它玩命，它分分钟教你做人。

ETHUSD
+2.23%
Ethereum remains locked in a corrective phase, with the price struggling to reclaim key resistance levels despite recent rebound attempts. While downside momentum has slowed, the market has yet to show the demand strength required to transition into a sustained bullish continuation.Technical Analysis

By ShayanThe Daily Chart

On the daily timeframe, ETH continues to trade below a dominant descending trendline that has capped the price action since the November peak. Each recovery attempt has stalled beneath this structure, reinforcing the broader corrective bias.

The asset is currently trading around the $3,1K level, below both the 100-day and 200-day moving averages. The 200-day moving average near the $3,4K to $3,5K zone aligns with a major daily supply area, which previously acted as a distribution region and continues to attract selling pressure.

Above current levels, the $3,3K to $3,6K zone remains the most critical resistance. A daily close above this area would be required to invalidate the descending structure and signal a potential trend shift. Until then, upside moves are likely to remain corrective in nature.

On the downside, the $2.6K to $2.5K demand zone stands out as the most significant support area. This region represents the origin of the strongest bullish impulse earlier in the cycle and sits near the lower boundary of the broader market structure. A revisit of this zone would still be structurally consistent with the ongoing correction.

The 4-Hour Chart

The 4-hour chart shows Ethereum trading inside a rising corrective channel nested within the larger downtrend. While higher lows have formed in the short term, the asset remains capped by both the descending trendline and a local supply zone around $3,3 to $3,4.

Recent price action shows repeated rejections from this resistance cluster, followed by shallow pullbacks rather than impulsive continuation. This behaviour suggests absorption rather than aggressive buying.

If Ethereum fails to reclaim the $3.3K level with strength, downside liquidity is likely to be targeted near the $3K psychological level, followed by the $2.9K support region highlighted on the chart. A breakdown from the rising channel would increase the probability of a deeper move toward the daily demand zone.

Only a clean break above the descending trendline, accompanied by strong follow-through, would shift short-term momentum decisively in favour of buyers.

subTitle:
$ETH  has looked weak for the last two days, like it had no energy. Then last night it dropped fast and tested the low area again and again. That dip hit big buy orders and pushed ETH back up from the edge of $3,000. Now ETH is sitting near $3,120, but the big question is simple. Is this the start of a real move up, or is it just a short bounce before another fall.
What makes this interesting is what whales are doing. One big whale bought hard during the drop. Reports say the buys were in the $3,030 to $3,150 range and the total was near $92.7M. But even after buying, that whale is sitting on a very large unrealized loss, said to be around $22M. At the same time another whale has been pulling ETH from Binance in a big way. One report says about 38,576 ETH was withdrawn in a short time. When whales pull coins off an exchange, many traders read it as a sign they want to hold and possibly push a move later.
This creates a mixed but powerful picture. Some whales look trapped in long positions but still refuse to sell. Others are stacking coins like they believe this level will hold. That shows strong support around this zone, but it does not guarantee a moon move. Big money can be wrong too. The market can still shake them out if momentum does not return.
Price action also looks split depending on the time frame. On the short chart, the drop formed a clear quick recovery. ETH dipped near $3,022 and bounced fast, which looks like a double bottom idea on the smaller view. That kind of bounce can bring a push toward the $3,200 to $3,300 area if buyers keep stepping in. But on the bigger daily view, ETH still looks heavy. The trend does not look fully flipped yet, and many traders see $3,300 as the key line. If ETH cannot close strong above $3,300, the move can stay only a rebound and not a full trend change.
Right now ETH feels like it got saved at the last second, but it is still not fully strong. The whales gave the market a boost, yet the next step depends on whether ETH can build above the key level instead of fading again. In a market like this, chasing the pump can hurt fast. Waiting for clean levels can be safer.

🔥Consensus Revolution: How Ethereum Transitioned from 'Burning Energy' to 'Pooling Capital'

Have you ever wondered what the most important upgrade of Ethereum, 'The Merge', really changed? It was not just a transition from 'Mining' to 'Staking'. Behind this is a profound consensus revolution from 'Proof of Work' (PoW) to 'Proof of Stake' (PoS).

Change in Core Philosophy: From 'Physical Competition' to 'Economic Game'

⭐️In the Past (PoW): Security relied on 'Physical Computing Power', where miners competed to consume energy to prove themselves; it was an outward, resource-consuming competition.
⭐️Now (PoS): Security relies on 'Staked Economic Rights'. Validators need to stake ETH as 'Collateral', and their interests are deeply tied to network security. This is an inward game based on economic incentives and penalties.

This has brought about three fundamental improvements:

⭐️Leap in Energy Efficiency: The network's energy consumption has directly decreased by about 99.95%, steering it towards sustainable development.
⭐️Upgrade in Security Model: The cost of attacking the network has shifted from 'Buying Massive Hardware' to 'Controlling Vast Capital' (which requires controlling about two-thirds of the staked ETH). The security defense line has moved from the physical world to the purely economic realm, making it more solid.
⭐️Opening New Possibilities: PoS provides a clear technological path for Ethereum's future sharding expansion, laying the foundation for greater scalability.

Deeper Impact: Shaping a New Economic System
PoS not only changed the security model but also created a powerful economic flywheel. Staking transformed ETH from 'Fuel' into the network's 'Productive Asset' and 'Security Cornerstone'. This attracted institutional capital seeking stable returns, which through staking became the network's maintainers, further enhancing security and trust, thereby attracting more value.

In simple terms, the transition to PoS is a key leap for Ethereum from a 'Global Computer' to an 'Open Economic System Maintained by Global Capital'. Its impact is gradually unfolding before our eyes.

🔥共识革命：当以太坊从“燃烧能源”转向“凝聚资本”

有没有想过，以太坊最重要的升级“合并”到底改变了什么？它不仅仅是从“挖矿”变成了“质押”。这背后，是从 “工作量证明”（PoW）到“权益证明”（PoS） 的一场深刻共识革命。

核心理念之变：从“物理竞争”到“经济博弈”

⭐️过去（PoW）：安全依靠“物理算力”，矿工竞相消耗能源来证明自己，是一种外向的、资源消耗型的竞争。
⭐️现在（PoS）：安全依靠 “质押的经济权益” 。验证者需要质押ETH作为“保证金”，其利益与网络安全深度绑定。这是一种内向的、基于经济激励与惩罚的博弈。

这带来了三重根本性提升：

⭐️能源效率飞跃：网络能耗直接降低了约99.95%，使其走向可持续发展。
⭐️安全模式升级：攻击网络的成本从“购买海量硬件”转变为“掌控天量资本”（需控制约三分之二质押的ETH），安全防线从物理世界转移到了纯粹的经济领域，更加稳固。
⭐️开启全新可能：PoS为以太坊未来的分片扩容提供了清晰的技术路径，是迈向更高可扩展性的基础。

更深远的影响：塑造新的经济系统
PoS不仅改变了安全模式，更创造了一个强大的经济飞轮。质押让ETH从“燃料”转变为了网络的“生产性资产”和“安全基石”。这吸引了寻求稳健回报的机构资本，他们通过质押成为网络的维护者，进一步增强了安全与信任，从而吸引更多价值入驻。

简单说，转向PoS，是以太坊从一台“全球计算机”进化为一个 “由全球资本共同维护的开放经济系统” 的关键一跃。它的影响，正在我们眼前徐徐展开。

title: Ethereum Foundation's AI Head Advocates for Algorithm Transparency
subTitle:
According to Foresight News, Davide Crapis, the AI head at the Ethereum Foundation, recently tweeted that platforms claiming to support free speech should make their algorithm optimization goals public and ensure they are readable and adjustable by users. In response, Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin suggested taking it a step further by implementing zero-knowledge proofs for every algorithmic decision. He also recommended timestamping content and like/retweet records on the blockchain to prevent server tampering or censorship, and proposed releasing the complete algorithm code after a delay of 1-2 years.

Ethereum Exchange Outflows Cool Sharply After Last Week’s Spike

Ethereum continues to see net outflows from centralized exchanges, but the pace has slowed significantly. Over the past 7 days, CEXs recorded a total net outflow of 25,100 ETH, a sharp drop from the 206,400 ETH withdrawn the previous week.

The largest contributors to outflows were Coinbase Pro with 11,200 ETH, followed by Binance at 4,652.85 ETH and Kraken with 3,811 ETH. On the other side, Gate stood out as the top exchange seeing inflows, with 415.6 ETH moving in.

This shift suggests the aggressive withdrawal phase may be easing, moving from urgency-driven flows to a more balanced consolidation phase. While ETH is still leaving exchanges on net, the reduced speed implies less immediate pressure on liquidity dynamics.

Exchange flows often change before price structure does. For now, the signal isn’t exhaustion — it’s normalization after an extreme move.

title: 高市昏招迭出，日本沦为中美俄“出气筒”，自作孽不可活
subTitle:
日本首相高市早苗最近捅了大娄子，她发表涉台错误言论后，中国立马展开全面反制，把她逼得走投无路。这高市为了给自己找靠山，赶紧宣布要访美，按日本媒体的说法，就是想去抱美国大腿。
可还没等她登上去美国的飞机，她那极右翼阵营里的“猪队友”就出来捣乱了。跟她关系不错的日本自卫队退役将领、极右翼政客田母神俊雄，突然在社交媒体上对美国开炮，说珍珠港事件是美国对日本的栽赃抹黑，还声称是美国把日本拖进了战争。这说法一出来，马上就有人反驳，说日本偷袭珍珠港就是为了抢原油搞侵略扩张。很明显，美国在中日外交危机里的表现，让日本极右翼势力很失望，所以他们才篡改历史来回应。
田母神俊雄这番言论，纯粹就是给急着访美的高市找麻烦。美国总统本来对日本就没好感，看到日本极右翼政客这么混账的言论，还能给高市好脸色？其实，对于高市要访美的消息，美国那边一直没回应，明显还在犹豫。毕竟让这么个“麻烦制造者”访美，肯定会给中美关系带来更多变数。现在田母神俊雄又发表这种颠倒黑白的言论，要是美国想拒绝高市访问，这不就是现成的借口？所以要是之后传出美国拒绝高市访问的消息，大家也别觉得意外。原因很简单，美国在中日外交危机里已经选了边，拒绝站队。
现在中国从外交、军事、经济等各方面对日本进行全面反制，给日本的安全、经济和民生都造成了巨大影响。而且中国还联合俄罗斯，从南北两个方向对日本形成军事包围，敲打日本，就是要遏制日本右翼势力复辟军国主义。美国在中日外交危机里拒绝站队，其实就是默许中俄收拾日本。美国不但不支持日本，还在关税、双边贸易和对美投资等方面敲诈日本，让日本在承受中俄压力的同时，还得分精力应对美国的讹诈。可以说，就因为高市这张破嘴，日本现在陷入了被中美俄三个大国“围殴”的困境。
面对这么糟糕的局面，高市还访不访美，外界也不知道。但她最新决定显示，日本好像打算绕过美国，跟欧盟勾搭上，好增强自己应对中俄压力的能力。最新消息说，当地时间12号，欧盟委员会发言人宣布，日本正式申请加入“欧洲安全行动”防务计划。有分析认为，特朗普不愿明确支持日本，日本就利用美欧关系紧张的机会，向这个想跟美国防务切割的计划提交申请，动机很明显。
这明显就是高市在没办法的情况下病急乱投医。美国不支持日本，她走投无路，只能向美国的对手“求救”。这也就不难理解田母神俊雄为啥敢公然挑衅美国了，原来是日本觉得自己找到“新靠山”了。之前有人说高市说话不过脑子，现在看，她做事也不过脑子。她也不想想这么做对美日同盟有啥影响，就欧洲现在这情况，能给日本提供啥支持？#美联储降息 #加密市场反弹 #ETH

After she made incorrect remarks regarding Taiwan, China immediately launched a comprehensive counterattack, leaving her with no way out. To find support for herself, Takaichi quickly announced her intention to visit the U.S., according to Japanese media, wanting to cling to America.
Before she could even board the plane to the United States, her 'teammate' from the far-right camp caused trouble. Toshiaki Tamogami, a retired general of the Japanese Self-Defense Forces and far-right politician who had a good relationship with her, suddenly launched an attack on the United States on social media, claiming that the Pearl Harbor incident was a smear campaign by the U.S. against Japan, and asserted that it was the U.S. that dragged Japan into the war. Once this statement was made, someone immediately refuted it, saying that Japan's surprise attack on Pearl Harbor was to seize oil and expand its aggression. It is clear that the U.S. performance during the Sino-Japanese diplomatic crisis has greatly disappointed the Japanese far-right forces, which is why they altered history in response.

title: Ethereum at a Key $3,000 Pivot: What Vietnamese Investors Should Do Now
subTitle:
Ethereum is trading just above the critical $3,000–3,050 zone after a pullback from the mid-$3,600s, with price currently hovering around $3,050–3,150 and intraday trend still under pressure. Short term, the market is defensive; medium term, ETH is consolidating in a range that could become the launchpad for the next leg higher if buyers defend $3,000.
1. Current price structure and market context  
- ETH recently broke down from the $3,590–3,650 area, with strong selling volume confirming a shift from bullish momentum to corrective mode.  
- Price has since drifted lower toward $3,020–3,050, which is now acting as the main battleground between bulls and bears.  
- On lower time frames, ETH is trading below $3,200 and below the 100‑hour moving average, with a clear bearish trend line capping rebounds near $3,150–3,180.  
- Some technical desks see $3,000–3,020 as the “decision zone”:  
  - A successful defense here could fuel a rebound toward $3,250–3,300 and potentially $3,400.  
  - A clean break below could open the door to $2,878–2,900, and on a weekly basis even a $2,500–2,700 retest is on the table if selling accelerates.
2. Sentiment, flows and on-chain tone  
- Derivatives and ETF flow data point to cooling institutional appetite, with net outflows from ETH products recently, signalling reduced risk-on behavior from large players.  
- At the same time, on-chain data show that long‑term holder selling pressure has started to ease: net distribution has declined compared to earlier in the month, suggesting that forced or panic selling is slowing.  
- Overall sentiment is mixed: short‑term fear and caution, but without the kind of capitulation typical of a macro top.
3. Bigger‑picture trend and 2025 outlook  
- Structurally, ETH is still in a broader uptrend from cycle lows, but currently in a mid‑cycle correction/sideways phase rather than a clear bull continuation.  
- Several analytical models and forecasts project that ETH could trade in a $3,000–3,700 band into year‑end, with some more optimistic scenarios targeting new highs above $6,000+ later in the cycle if:  
  - Macro conditions remain supportive (no major liquidity shock).  
  - Ethereum’s roadmap (scaling, L2 growth, restaking, real‑world assets, DeFi recovery) continues to attract users and capital.  
- For Vietnamese investors, this means volatility around $3,000 may be an opportunity zone, but not a place to over‑leverage or ignore risk.
4. Key technical levels to watch  
Support:  
- $3,020–3,050: First and most important local support. Lose this cleanly on high volume and probability of a move to $2,878–2,900 rises.  
- $2,500–2,700: Deeper, higher‑time‑frame demand zone if the correction extends.
Resistance:  
- $3,150: First intraday resistance (also near 50% retracement of the recent downswing).  
- $3,175–3,180: Bearish trend‑line area; repeated rejection here keeps bears in control.  
- $3,200: “Flip the script” level. Sustained trading back above $3,200 would be the first confirmation of a transition from mere relief bounce to genuine recovery.  
- $3,250–3,320–3,400: Next upside targets if $3,200 is reclaimed and defended.
5. Strategy suggestions for individual investors in Vietnam  
These are not financial advice, but structured scenarios to consider:
a) If you are underexposed to ETH (long‑term believer, little position)  
- Consider laddered spot entries around the current zone instead of trying to catch the exact bottom.  
  - Example approach: allocate in tranches around $3,050–3,100, leave dry powder for a possible $2,900–2,700 extension.  
- Focus on multi‑year thesis (Ethereum as base layer for DeFi, L2s, tokenization) rather than day‑to‑day volatility.  
- In VND terms, be aware that FX risk (USD/VND) also matters; avoid using leverage simply to “catch up”.
b) If you are already heavily allocated to ETH  
- Reassess your risk per level:  
  - If your average entry is much lower (e.g., below $2,000), you can usually tolerate a test of $2,500–2,700 without emotional decisions.  
  - If your average entry is high (above $3,500), consider whether a partial de‑risking on bounces toward $3,250–3,400 fits your plan.  
- Avoid panic selling directly into $3,000 support unless your broader risk management is broken; historically, such major levels often produce strong bounces, even within a larger downtrend.  
- Make sure your position size still allows you to sleep at night; if not, reduce gradually on strength.
c) For active traders (short‑term, more experienced)  
- Bullish tactical plan:  
  - Look for a clear defense of $3,020–3,050 (higher lows on 4H, declining sell volume).  
  - Potential long setups with first targets $3,150 → $3,180 → $3,200, then $3,250–3,320 if momentum improves.  
  - Keep stops relatively tight below $3,000; if that breaks with volume, step aside.  
- Bearish tactical plan:  
  - Watch for rejection wicks and heavy sell volume near $3,150–3,180.  
  - Short setups targeting $3,020–3,000, with extension to $2,900 if support gives way.  
  - Strict risk management: avoid oversizing in a still‑range‑bound market.
d) Risk management principles (especially important in Vietnam’s retail context)  
- Prefer spot over high leverage; many Vietnamese investors get wiped out by over‑leveraged futures around major levels like $3,000.  
- Use position sizing instead of “all in / all out”: scale in and out.  
- Always plan in VND terms: think about the real impact on your savings, not just the percentage on screen.  
- Separate:  
  - Core long‑term ETH stack (untouched, held through cycles).  
  - Trading stack (smaller, used for active strategies with predefined stop loss).
6. How to think about the coming weeks  
- Base case: continued choppy range around $3,000 with fake breakouts both ways as the market digests macro news, ETF flows and year‑end positioning.  
- Bullish path:  
  - $3,020–3,050 holds → ETH reclaims $3,200 → market targets $3,250–3,400, and discussion of a new run toward $4,000 re‑emerges.  
- Bearish path:  
  - $3,020–3,000 fails on strong volume → acceleration to $2,878–2,900, possibly extending to $2,500–2,700 before a stronger long‑term buying opportunity appears.  
For now, Vietnamese individual investors should treat $3,000 as the main line in the sand: be patient, avoid emotional trades, and prepare plans for both rebound and deeper correction instead of trying to guess the exact next candle.

subTitle:
On the surface, Ethereum {ETH}appears to be in a holding pattern. The last 24 hours show minimal movement, and the week-long gain is a modest 2.6\%. Yet, for seasoned market observers, this silence is not apathy it is the sound of compression. {ETH} is consolidating near critical technical and psychological levels, a phase that historically precedes a significant expansion of volatility.
The key question now is whether the slow, steady build-up of buying interest can finally resolve this consolidation into a powerful upward trajectory

​The Bull Flag Thesis: A Textbook Pause
​Technically, Ethereum is tracing out what appears to be a classic bull flag pattern. This formation is a welcome sign after a strong uptrend; it signifies a healthy pause, allowing the market to absorb supply and consolidate gains before the next move higher.
The integrity of this bullish structure hinges on one critical level: $3,090.
​Key Support Confirmed: $ETH  has held firmly above the $3,100 mark across multiple sessions. This zone is acting as a robust floor, where recurring selling pressure has been reliably met and absorbed by buyers. As long as a daily close remains above $3,090, the technical outlook remains constructive, suggesting that the market is actively defending the consolidation structure.
The moment traders are waiting for is a clean daily close above $3,130. This breach would act as the first major technical confirmation, signaling the end of the consolidation phase and the likely start of a bullish breakout move.
On-Chain Data Signals Easing Pressure
​Adding weight to the technical case is a subtle but significant shift in on-chain dynamics. Analysis of the Holder Net Position Change metric reveals that the intensity of selling by long-term holders is easing.
​Recent data shows a discernible decline in the net amount of $ETH  being distributed by holders. While accumulation hasn't fully taken over, the rate of selling has slowed significantly dropping by approximately 8.4\% in a recent 24-hour period.
​This is a powerful signal:
​Sellers are losing momentum. The supply coming onto the market is drying up as the price compresses near resistance.
​No Panic: The market is not experiencing the kind of panic selling typical of a bearish breakdown. Instead, holders appear to be exhibiting patience, increasingly willing to wait for a price breakout.
​This alignment strong technical defense at support coupled with easing selling pressureoften sets the stage for a sharp move higher once the confirmation level is hit.
If the Breakout Confirms: Targets in Focus
​Should Ethereum secure that decisive daily close above $3,130, the measured move suggests a path to significant upside.
​Intermediate Resistance: The first major resistance zone is set near $3,390. Clearing this level would be a major victory for buyers.  
​Major Target Zone: A decisive break above $3,390 would significantly strengthen the bullish narrative, opening the door toward the $4,000 to $4,020 range. This target aligns closely with the measured projection of the current bull flag structure, giving it higher technical validity.
Risk Management: The Line in the Sand
​Despite the constructive setup, prudent risk management is essential.
​The bullish structure begins to weaken if \text{ETH} falls back below $3,090.
​The bull flag thesis is entirely invalidated by a daily close below $2,910. A drop to this level would signal a shift in market structure, likely reintroducing strong downside pressure and forcing a complete reassessment of the broader trend.
​Final Takeaway
​Ethereum is currently sitting on a powder keg of compressed volatility. The confluence of a well-defined bull flag, resilient support at $3,100, and declining selling pressure from long-term holders paints a distinctly bullish picture. The market is not yet running, but the coiled spring is tightly wound. The next major directional move will be triggered by that confirmed daily close above the $3,130 resistance

The main players could have left a long time ago. I watched ETH for a while during the day, and the structure is more stable than I expected. The position at 3122 has been tested several times without breaking down, and the volume hasn't significantly increased, making me feel that the bears are losing their strength. The RSI is wavering at 51.2, neither strong nor weak, just stuck in the middle ground, as if waiting for some signal. As an old investor, I've seen this many times; it's the easiest time to be deceived—just when you think there will be a pullback, a strong bullish candle takes off; just when you think there will be a breakthrough, it immediately gives you a deep wash.

Currently, it does seem that the bulls are in control, the daily trend hasn't broken down, the middle band of the Bollinger Bands is holding up, and the MACD is still sticking above water, indicating some accumulation. But to be honest, I really don't dare to chase heavily right now. The shadow of getting trapped when chasing high at 3400 last month is still fresh, and the pain of cutting losses is too much.

I think there are two possibilities ahead. One is a gentle upward move, slowly grinding above 3200 to fill that previous gap, and then oscillating in the 3250-3300 range. This scenario is the most comfortable and is suitable for those who can hold on to accumulate positions gradually. The other possibility is a sudden drop, breaking below 3100, burying all the short-term traders who followed the trend recently, and then having a “deep V” rebound. I've seen this script too many times; the big players love to play this way and are good at punishing those who are not compliant.

Personally, I lean slightly bullish, as the Ethereum ecosystem hasn't been bad recently, Layer 2 is active, and staking volume is increasing, with the fundamentals not collapsing. Moreover, Bitcoin is stabilizing above 60,000, providing breathing room for altcoins. However, I won't go all in right now; at most, I'll lightly test a short-term long, set a stop loss, and take some emotional profit before running. If I really want to go big, I still need to see if it can stabilize above 3250.

Ultimately, until the trend is established, no one knows whether tomorrow will be a surge or a crash. For us small retail investors, what we can do is not be greedy, not hold on, and not fantasize. When it's time to observe, we should just sit with idle money and watch the show; opportunities are always reserved for those who last until the end. Brothers, let's encourage each other.
I originally didn't plan to manage this.

【老实讲，ETH 现在这走法让我有点坐不住】

主力要走，其实早就能走了。盘中盯着ETH看了一会儿，结构比想象中稳。3122这个位置反复试了几次都没跌破，量也没明显放大，感觉空头已经有点有气无力了。RSI在51.2晃悠，不强也不弱，刚好卡在中间地带，像是在等什么信号。我这种老韭菜见得多了，这种时候最容易骗人——你以为要回调，结果一根阳线直接起飞；你以为要冲关，立马给你来个深水洗盘。

目前来看，多头确实占优，日线级别的趋势还没坏，布林带中轨撑着，MACD也还在水上粘合，有点蓄力的意思。但说实话，我现在真不敢重仓追。上个月在3400追高被套的阴影还在，割肉出来的教训太疼了。

接下来我觉得有两种可能。一种是温和上攻，慢慢磨到3200以上，补掉前面那个跳空缺口，然后在3250-3300区域再震荡整理。这种走法最舒服，适合拿得住的人逢低分批搞点底仓。另一种就是突然杀一波，破一下3100，把最近那些跟风的短线客全埋了，再来个“深V”反抽。这种剧本我也见过太多次了，庄家就爱这么玩，专治各种不服。

我个人倾向还是偏多一点，毕竟以太坊生态最近不算差，Layer2活跃，质押量也在涨，基本面没崩。而且比特币稳在6万上方，给山寨们留了喘息空间。但我不会现在一把梭哈，最多轻仓试个短多，设好止损，赚点情绪钱就跑。真要大干，还得看能不能站稳3250再说。

说到底，行情没走出来之前，谁也不知道明天是拉是砸。我们这些小散户，能做的就是别贪、别扛、别幻想。该观望时就拿着闲钱看看戏，机会永远留给活到最后的人。兄弟们，共勉吧。

Weekly Crypto Outlook: What I’m Watching This Week (BTC • ETH • Alts)

Market mood: Fear is elevated and positioning looks fragile, which often leads to sharp moves in both directions. This week feels more “macro-driven” than “narrative-driven,” so I’m prioritizing key events + liquidity levels over predictions.

1) The Macro Drivers (High Impact)

Bank of Japan (Dec 19)

If the BoJ signals tighter policy, it can strengthen JPY and pressure risk assets via carry-trade unwinds.
Translation: liquidity can tighten fast, and BTC/Alts often feel it first.

US data flow (jobs/inflation surprises)

Anything that shifts rate-cut expectations can push crypto quickly.
Watch for volatility spikes around releases (fakeouts are common).

2) BTC Outlook (Range first, then expansion)

Base case: choppy consolidation unless a macro headline hits.

Support zone: ~88k area first; then ~85k as a deeper liquidity pocket.
Resistance zone: ~93k area; reclaiming and holding it improves bullish odds.

Bull scenario: BTC reclaims resistance, open interest stays controlled, spot demand holds → grind up and squeeze shorts.
Bear scenario: macro shock + loss of support → fast sweep down (liquidity hunt), then watch for a reaction bounce.

3) ETH & Alts (Selective strength, but fragile)

If BTC is unstable, most alts remain “high beta” (they drop harder).
ETH can outperform if it holds key supports and BTC stays rangebound.
I’m looking for relative strength leaders (coins holding up while BTC chops) rather than chasing random pumps.

4) My Game Plan (Simple)

Don’t fight macro headlines.
Trade levels, not feelings: wait for reclaim/confirmation near support/resistance.
Size down if volatility expands; protect capital first.

Not financial advice. Just my watchlist and framework for the week.

Bitcoin's bull cycles have historically seen diminishing returns, with significant pullbacks following record highs.

The current cycle saw prices double to $126,000 before pulling back to under $90,000, breaking the parabolic trend.

Veteran trader and chart analyst Peter Brandt has warned that bitcoin's BTC$89,785.42 signature growth parabola has fractured, opening the door to a brutal slide potentially down to $25,000.

Brandt's call hinges on exponential decay in bitcoin's bull cycles. The cryptocurrency has historically rallied hard in 12-18 months after halving and subsequently slipped into a bear market, characterized by 70% to 80% pullback from record highs.

However, each bull cycle has seen diminishing returns. For instance, following the first halving on Nov. 28, 2012, BTC chalked out a 100-fold rise to $1,240 by December 2013. The 2016 halving produced a 74-fold rise and the 2020 halving brought an eight-fold rise.

The latest post-halving cycle, which kicked off following the quadrennial event in April 2024, saw prices double to a record high of $126,000 by October this year. Since then, prices have pulled back to just under $90,000, slicing through the parabola curve that has marked massive price uptrends during each prior cycle.

The current parabolic advance has been violated. 20% of ATH = $25,240," Brandt said on X.

title: Crypto and Fintech Titans Join Forces to Secure the Future of Prediction Markets
subTitle:
A powerful coalition of leading crypto and fintech platforms is moving to shape the regulatory future of prediction markets in the United States. By pushing for clear federal oversight, the group aims to protect access to a fast-growing sector while preventing a patchwork of state-level crackdowns that could fragment an industry increasingly tied to data, forecasting, and public insight.
Industry Leaders Unite Around Federal Oversight
Major financial and crypto platforms have coordinated a new industry initiative centered on federal regulation. The newly formed Coalition for Prediction Markets brings together Kalshi, Crypto.com, Coinbase, Robinhood, and Underdog, with a shared goal of ensuring that prediction markets operate under a consistent national framework rather than conflicting state rules.
Speaking on December 11, Matt David, a board member of the coalition and North America president and head of corporate affairs at Crypto.com, described the moment as pivotal. He characterized the United States as the largest frontier for prediction markets and argued that the momentum now underway makes a unified industry voice not just important, but essential.
David framed prediction markets as more than a niche financial product, calling them a new layer of civic infrastructure. In his view, these platforms function as public-service technology, offering clearer signals to individuals while helping institutions make better-informed decisions. He emphasized that the coalition intends to advocate for responsible growth and transparency as regulatory discussions evolve.
Data, Demand, and the Push Back Against Fragmentation
Industry data highlighted by the group suggests that prediction markets outperform traditional polling by roughly 30 percent and have generated close to $28 billion in total trading volume through October. Public opinion research cited by the coalition also indicates that a majority of voters favor federal oversight over a fragmented system of state-by-state regulation.
The timing of the coalition’s launch is not accidental. Several state-level gaming regulators have recently sought to expand their authority into prediction markets, despite the sector’s long-standing treatment as a federally regulated space. Coalition members argue that allowing individual states to assert control would introduce uncertainty and undermine the integrity of markets that rely on uniform rules.
Sara Slane, head of corporate development at Kalshi and a member of the coalition’s executive committee, said that federal regulation has always been the goal. She pointed to years of engagement with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission to build safeguards against insider trading, market manipulation, and consumer harm. According to Slane, Americans deserve regulatory clarity rather than “50 conflicting interpretations.”
Prediction Markets as a Tool for Truth Discovery
Coinbase’s chief policy officer, Faryar Shirzad, echoed that sentiment, tying prediction markets directly to the company’s broader mission. He argued that these markets naturally democratize truth-seeking by allowing participants to express beliefs through price signals rather than opinions alone, making them a powerful mechanism for collective insight.
Looking ahead, the coalition’s initial priorities include reinforcing federal standards, resisting state-level overreach related to sports, elections, and economic indicators, and promoting consistent integrity rules nationwide. The group says these steps are critical to keeping prediction markets transparent, accessible, and subject to uniform oversight.
As prediction markets continue to expand beyond niche use cases into mainstream tools for forecasting and information discovery, the alliance signals a clear message: the industry wants federal clarity, not regulatory confusion, to define its next phase of growth.

title: بيتكوين وإيثيريوم والريبل تتداول تحت الضغط وسط إشارات متباينة من التجزئة والتحليل الفني
subTitle:
{spot}(BTCUSDT)
 
{spot}(ETHUSDT)
 
{spot}(XRPUSDT)
 ارتفع سعر البيتكوين نحو 90000 دولار كحاجز مقاومة أولي، مدعومًا بزيادة ثابتة في الفائدة المفتوحة للعقود الآجلة.استعاد الإيثريوم 3100 دولار، لكن المتوسطات المتحركة الأسيّة لمدة 50 و100 و200 يوم قد تستمر في تقييد الارتدادات.XRP على وشك كسر الحاجز الفوري عند 2.00 دولار، مدعومًا بزيادة طفيفة في الطلب من التجزئة.
يتقدم البيتكوين ($BTC ) نحو 90000 دولار في وقت كتابة هذا التقرير يوم الاثنين، حيث يدفع سوق العملات المشفرة الأوسع نحو التعافي بعد رياح معاكسة ناجمة عن السياسة النقدية في الأسبوع الماضي.
يستقر الإيثريوم ($ETH ) فوق 3100 دولار على الرغم من مواجهة طلب تجزئة غير مستقر. في الوقت نفسه،( $XRP )على وشك استعادة موقعه فوق 2.00 دولار، مدعومًا بزيادة طفيفة في الفائدة المفتوحة للعقود الآجلة (OI).
تسليط الضوء على البيانات: سوق التجزئة للبيتكوين ينمو، والإيثريوم وXRP يواجهان صعوبات
يظهر سوق مشتقات البيتكوين علامات على النمو مع عودة اهتمام التجزئة بعد فترة طويلة من التوقف. تُظهر بيانات CoinGlass أن متوسط الفائدة المفتوحة للعقود الآجلة بلغ 61.35 مليار دولار يوم الاثنين، ارتفاعًا من 59.8 مليار دولار في اليوم السابق.
انخفضت الفائدة المفتوحة، التي تتعقب القيمة الاسمية للعقود الآجلة المعلقة، إلى أدنى مستوى لها في تسعة أشهر عند 56.32 مليار دولار في 7 ديسمبر. لوضع هذا في السياق، بلغ ذروة الطلب من التجزئة عند أعلى مستوى له على الإطلاق 94.12 مليار دولار في 7 أكتوبر، قبل أكبر حدث تخفيض للرافعة المالية في 10 أكتوبر.
تشير الزيادة الثابتة في الفائدة المفتوحة إلى أن المتداولين من التجزئة واثقون من آفاق البيتكوين؛ ومن ثم، فإن استعدادهم لزيادة التعرض.

الفائدة المفتوحة للبيتكوين | المصدر: CoinGlass
يواجه الإيثريوم رياحًا معاكسة، حيث تراجع الطلب من التجزئة إلى 39.32 مليار دولار من 41.32 مليار دولار يوم الجمعة. وصلت الفائدة المفتوحة للعقود الآجلة إلى أعلى مستوى لها على الإطلاق عند 70.13 مليار دولار في 23 أغسطس لكنها انخفضت إلى أدنى مستوى لها في ستة أشهر عند 32.57 مليار دولار في 22 نوفمبر.

الفائدة المفتوحة للإيثريوم | المصدر: CoinGlass
يبقى اهتمام التجزئة في XRP منخفضًا بشكل كبير على الرغم من أن الفائدة المفتوحة للعقود الآجلة بلغت 3.72 مليار دولار يوم الاثنين، ارتفاعًا من 3.57 مليار دولار في اليوم السابق. بالمقارنة، بلغت الفائدة المفتوحة ذروتها عند 10.94 مليار دولار في 22 يوليو، مما يشير إلى اهتمام مدفوع بالخوف من الفوات. يتطلب التعافي المستدام في الفائدة المفتوحة دعمًا لتعافي الأسعار.

الفائدة المفتوحة لـ XRP | المصدر: CoinGlass
رسم بياني اليوم: البيتكوين يترقب اختراقًا قصير الأجل
يتجه البيتكوين نحو 90000 دولار في وقت كتابة هذا التقرير يوم الاثنين، مدعومًا بمؤشر القوة النسبية (RSI) المتصاعد على الرسم البياني اليومي. إذا ارتفع مؤشر القوة النسبية عند 44 فوق خط المنتصف إلى المنطقة الصعودية، ستزداد الزخم، مما يدعم اختراقًا ممتدًا فوق 90000 دولار.
يظهر مؤشر تباعد تقارب المتوسط المتحرك (MACD) على نفس الرسم البياني اليومي زخمًا إيجابيًا طفيفًا، مع بقاء الخط الأزرق فوق خط الإشارة الأحمر. سيفكر المستثمرون في زيادة تعرضهم للمخاطر إذا تقدم مؤشر MACD واخترق إلى المنطقة الصعودية بينما تتوسع الأشرطة الخضراء في المدرج التكراري فوق خط المتوسط.
ومع ذلك، يبقى الاتجاه عمومًا هبوطيًا، حيث يمتد المتوسط المتحرك الأسي لمدة 50 يومًا عند 95605 دولار، والمتوسط المتحرك الأسي لمدة 100 يوم عند 101025 دولار، والمتوسط المتحرك الأسي لمدة 200 يوم عند 103051 دولار في انخفاضها. من المحتمل أن تظل الارتدادات محدودة ما لم يتم كسر المتوسط المتحرك الأسي لمدة 50 يومًا، مما يمهد الطريق لتحقيق مكاسب فوق 100000 دولار.

الرسم البياني اليومي لـ BTC/USDT
تحديث العملات البديلة: ثيران الإيثريوم تشدد قبضتها بينما XRP يبقى دون المقاومة
يتداول الإيثريوم فوق 3100 دولار في وقت كتابة هذا التقرير يوم الاثنين بعد الارتداد من أدنى مستوى له يوم الأحد عند 3024 دولار. استعاد مؤشر القوة النسبية فوق خط المنتصف 50، مما يشير إلى زيادة الزخم الصعودي.
حافظ مؤشر MACD على إشارة شراء منذ 26 نوفمبر وهو على وشك الدخول في المنطقة الصعودية. إذا توسعت الأشرطة الخضراء في المدرج التكراري فوق خط المتوسط، سيتم تحفيز المستثمرين لزيادة تعرضهم للمخاطر لتعزيز الزخم.
قد يحد المتوسط المتحرك الأسي لمدة 50 يومًا عند 3282 دولار من الارتدادات، ولكن إذا تم كسره، يمكن أن يمتد الإيثريوم فوق المتوسط المتحرك الأسي لمدة 200 يوم عند 3440 دولار والمتوسط المتحرك الأسي لمدة 100 يوم عند 3476 دولار. قد يؤدي الفشل في كسر المتوسط المتحرك الأسي لمدة 50 يومًا إلى تقييد ارتفاع ETH وزيادة فرص التصحيح إلى ما دون 3000 دولار.

الرسم البياني اليومي لـ ETH/USDT
يتداول XRP قليلاً دون المقاومة الأولية عند 2.00 دولار بعد استعادة الزخم من أدنى مستوى له يوم الأحد عند 1.95 دولار. تشير زيادة طفيفة في مؤشر القوة النسبية إلى أن الثيران قد تكتسب ميزة على الدببة. ومع ذلك، فإن موقعه عند 41 في المنطقة الهبوطية يشير إلى أن XRP لا يزال عميقًا في الغاية.

الرسم البياني اليومي لـ XRP/USDT
يمتد مؤشر MACD بشكل جانبي، مع وجود خط الإشارة الأحمر أسفل الخط الأزرق على الرسم البياني اليومي، مما يدعم فرضية هبوطية. يتداول XRP أيضًا دون المتوسط المتحرك الأسي لمدة 50 يومًا عند 2.21 دولار، والمتوسط المتحرك الأسي لمدة 200 يوم عند 2.38 دولار والمتوسط المتحرك الأسي لمدة 100 يوم عند 2.45 دولار، مما يحد من التعافي المحتمل. قد يؤدي الفشل في كسر المقاومة الأولية عند 2.00 دولار إلى دفع XRP لاختبار دعم 21 نوفمبر عند 1.82 دولار.

【ETH market is a bit off... The main force might really take action 🔥】

Sitting down in the evening to seriously watch the market, ETH has started to feel a bit interesting.  

I've been keeping an eye on ETH's market recently, and the price is currently stuck at 3158. To be honest, it's neither high nor low, but the volume is a bit subtle. When it retraced to 2900 earlier, I was actually quite anxious, and my positions were almost a costly lesson. Fortunately, I didn't sell and managed to hold on. These past few days, there's been a series of bullish candles; although it's not a violent surge, it's steady, and the bulls are clearly in control. RSI just crossed 53, neither hot nor cold, as if gathering strength.

However, the more I look, the more I feel something is off—the order book structure for buying and selling has changed. Previously, when large orders came crashing down, there were always people to catch them. Now, large orders piled up on the sell side are often suddenly halved without any deep dips, as if someone is quietly accumulating below. Moreover, on the hourly chart, each pullback is higher than the previous one, a typical ascending wedge consolidation. This trend either breaks down to wash out retail investors or directly surges up to challenge the previous high of 3400. Both possibilities exist, but I personally lean towards the latter.

Why? First, Bitcoin has stabilized recently, with no risk of a crash, giving altcoins and blue-chip coins some breathing room. Secondly, there have been occasional news from the Ethereum ecosystem, Layer 2 is heating up, and staking volume is increasing, the fundamentals haven't collapsed. Additionally, the Federal Reserve's tone has softened, liquidity expectations are warming up, and funds need an outlet; ETH, as a consensus-driven asset, can easily get a push.

Of course, I am also afraid of being proven wrong. If the market suddenly crashes or there are issues with on-chain data, then this bullish trend might just be a trap. So, I personally hold a base position, and I've set stop losses on the additional positions; if it truly breaks 3080, I’ll take my loss. After all, surviving this long isn't based on faith, but on the instinct to stay alive.

In the current market situation, saying it will surge makes me worry about missing out, while saying it will drop makes me fear losing out. I advise everyone not to heavily bet on the direction; observe whether it can stabilize at 3180 in the next 24 hours. It has now been over 4 weeks of continuous movement, with prices still oscillating above the midline of the weekly chart. Unlike the structure of 2022, a significant rebound has not yet occurred, but I still subjectively believe that a rebound will happen before the midline is broken;

The target is near the upper yellow line (104k) of the weekly oscillation channel.

The expectations for interest rate cuts in 2026 are currently quite weak, with market expectations around 25 to 50 basis points. My thinking is that lowering expectations now is beneficial, as it allows for some emotional pullbacks in the US stock market. Then, for reasons related to the midterm elections or others, Trump may have to adopt some fiscal policies similar to QE to stimulate the economy.

Therefore, the theme for 2026 may be "No pain, no gain!"

Simply referring to past cycle strategies is no longer feasible; we can only take it step by step. The best scenario is actually to exchange time for space, as prolonged oscillation above 70,000 can gradually reduce the depth of the final bear market.

When market supply is high, the demand side is in a defensive position, thus preserving living strength (the consensus that everyone should not rush and keep their money on hand), which essentially weakens the impact of the bear market and may even have a preemptive effect on future market recovery.

title: Bitcoin to Ethereum swaps rise as risk appetite grows
subTitle:
Ethereum tried to move higher a few days ago but failed near the 3400 dollar area. After that rejection price dropped fast and reached a short term low around 3045 dollars. Since then Ethereum has slowed down and started moving sideways. Right now price trades near 3118 dollars. Daily change is small while the weekly view shows a mild gain.

During this pullback many traders did not rush to sell. Instead they used the drop as a buying chance. This shows a shift in behavior. Rather than staying cautious money started to rotate. Funds moved out of Bitcoin and into other digital assets. Ethereum became the main choice in this move.

Large holders were a big part of this rotation. One major wallet shifted a huge amount of value from Bitcoin into Ethereum over a few days. Altogether this wallet converted 1969 Bitcoin into 58149 Ethereum. The total value crossed 180 million dollars. This happened while the wider market still looked weak which made the move more noticeable.

Bitcoin is often treated as the steady choice in the crypto market. Ethereum moves faster and swings harder but it can also rise more when conditions improve. Moving funds into Ethereum suggests these holders expect stronger gains ahead and are willing to accept more short term risk.

This move also lines up with a wider pattern. Money entering Bitcoin has fallen a lot since earlier in the year. At the same time many Ethereum coins are leaving trading platforms. When coins leave platforms it often means owners plan to hold them instead of selling. This points to quiet accumulation even while prices stay under pressure. Still overall market direction has not fully turned and downside pressure remains.

Interest in Ethereum has picked up in other areas too. Funds linked to Ethereum have shown positive pricing for several days. This means buyers are ready to pay extra to get exposure. It usually reflects strong confidence from larger players.

Lower supply on trading platforms can support price over time. When demand stays firm and available supply drops prices often react upward. Past market cycles have shown this pattern more than once.

Even so the structure is still fragile. Trend signals remain weak and selling pressure has not fully faded. Buyers are active but they have not taken full control yet.

If this softness continues Ethereum could find it hard to defend the 3000 dollar level. A clear move below that zone could drag price down toward 2800 dollars and test buyer strength again.

On the flip side steady buying could slowly change the trend. If price holds current levels and moves above nearby resistance it could signal a shift in momentum.

For now Ethereum sits at a key point. Big holders are taking chances. Demand signs are improving. Supply on platforms is shrinking. The next few moves will show whether this leads to a real rebound or just another pause before further downside.

title: How Robert Kiyosaki Built Wealth by Buying Silver at 18 and Smuggling Gold
subTitle:
Long before fame, book deals, or financial influence, Robert Kiyosaki made a quiet decision at the age of 18 that, in his view, set the foundation for everything that followed. Years later, another controversial move—buying and smuggling gold—cemented his belief that real wealth is built outside government-controlled money systems.
Building Wealth Outside Government Money
The Rich Dad Poor Dad author and longtime financial educator shared reflections on X last week, tracing the origins of his investment mindset and explaining why early, independent action matters more than reassurance from institutions—especially during long economic downturns.
Kiyosaki recalled that in 1965, when he was just 18 years old, he began saving what he called “real silver coins.” At the time, the U.S. government was in the process of removing silver from circulating coinage, replacing it with copper-nickel alloys. To Kiyosaki, this shift marked the transformation of money itself. Once silver was stripped from dimes, quarters, and eventually half dollars, he viewed the new coins as currency in name only.
Rather than accept that change, he chose to keep the silver. What began as a simple decision to save coins quietly evolved into a long-term strategy centered on holding assets he believed retained intrinsic value, regardless of policy decisions.
From Silver to Gold During Monetary Upheaval
That same line of thinking carried Kiyosaki into gold during the monetary turbulence of the early 1970s. He pointed to 1971 as a turning point, when President Richard Nixon removed the U.S. dollar from the gold standard. In Kiyosaki’s telling, this moment marked the beginning of a global debt-based economy and unleashed long-term instability in currencies.
The following year, he acted on those convictions. In 1972, Kiyosaki bought his first gold coin—a South African Krugerrand—for $50. At the time, U.S. citizens were prohibited from owning gold, which led him to smuggle the coin into the country. He has described the purchase not as a stunt, but as a deliberate effort to keep wealth beyond the reach of government control.
That commitment, he says, never faded. Decades later, Kiyosaki still holds gold and silver, storing part of it in Switzerland as a precaution. To illustrate the power of long-term hard-asset ownership, he noted that the same Krugerrand purchased for $50 is now worth roughly $4,500 as of December 10, 2025.
Linking Monetary Shifts to Today’s Debt Crisis
Kiyosaki connects these personal experiences to what he sees as a much larger, slow-moving financial breakdown. He argues that today’s economic stress is the result of decades of expanding debt and monetary manipulation. In his view, countries like the United States and Japan now stand as symbols of that imbalance, burdened by massive national debt.
He extends the warning to households as well, pointing to widespread mortgage obligations, student loans, and credit card debt. According to Kiyosaki, rising homelessness—even among those with jobs—reflects deeper structural issues rather than temporary hardship.
His central message is consistent with the themes that have defined his career. Financial crises do not arrive without warning, and they rarely happen overnight. Relying solely on wages, pensions, or bank savings, he argues, leaves individuals exposed when confidence in fiat currency erodes.
For that reason, Kiyosaki continues to advocate holding gold and silver alongside bitcoin, which he sees as a modern form of money existing outside the traditional banking system. In his view, education, early preparation, and ownership of assets beyond government control remain the most reliable defenses against long-term economic uncertainty.

🚨 $ETH ETHEREUM NETWORK INCIDENT BREAKDOWN 🚨

Month-Old Prysm Bug Triggers Ethereum Outage — Validators Lose 382 ETH
A previously undetected bug in Ethereum’s Prysm consensus client caused a temporary network disruption on Dec 4, exposing critical lessons about client diversity and testing at scale.

⚠️ What Happened

• Bug introduced in Prysm PR 15965, deployed on testnets weeks before Fusaka
• Never triggered until mainnet conditions aligned
• Out-of-sync attestations forced nodes to recompute past epochs, exhausting resources
• Result: cascading failures across Prysm validators

📉 Network Impact (42+ Epochs)
• Network participation dropped to 75%
• Missed slots peaked at 18.5%
• ~382 ETH lost in validator rewards
Despite the disruption, Ethereum avoided loss of finality.

🧩 Why Ethereum Survived This

Client diversity was the key safeguard:
• Prysm controls 17.6% of consensus clients
• Lighthouse holds 52.6%

Had the bug affected:
• >33% client share → temporary loss of finality
• >66% client share → risk of invalid chain finalization

🔁 Not the First Close Call

• May 2023: Ethereum briefly lost finality post-Shanghai fork
• both incidents resolved without permanent damage

Ethereum bent — but did not break.

title: 要是你今天被各种消息牵着鼻子走去做单，那基本已经输麻了
subTitle:
#币圈出了件特别典型，但90%散户都看不明白的事儿。
先是美联储降息，接着又传日本要加息，结果BTC、ETH价格不涨也不跌，就在那来回折腾。好多人直接懵圈了：“不是说降息吗，钱都跑哪去了？”“日本要加息，市场咋没崩呢？”
其实不是行情太诡异，是你看问题的角度不对。
市场最怕的不是利空，是没新消息
说句实在的，你今天看到的所有新闻，主力两周前就门儿清了。不管是降息还是日本加息，都不是突然冒出来的，早被反复讨论、反复交易过了。这意味着啥？新闻一出来，根本不是行情的起点，而是情绪的兑现点。所以你就看到，有利好，价格不涨；有利空，价格不跌，行情就在那像心电图似的晃悠。为啥？因为钱早就提前站好队了。
决定涨跌的不是新闻标题
好多人天天盯着快讯刷，却忽略了一个关键：价格不是被新闻推着走的，而是看资金愿不愿意继续留在市场里。给你提三个问题：有多少新增资金是打算长期进场的？有多少人只是想趁消息捞一笔就走？消息落地后，还有没有人接着入场？要是答案都不乐观，那价格就只能震荡、回调，把大家的情绪慢慢消耗掉。这就是为啥最近行情看着要起飞，结果一直踩刹车。
现在最危险的是谁
不是做空的，也不是做多的，而是被新闻牵着鼻子跑的人。看到“降息”就赶紧追涨，看到“加息”就慌忙割肉，K线都没看明白，仓位就先加上去了。情绪跟着消息起起伏伏，账户资金却一路下滑。市场最爱干的事儿，就是用看似合理的逻辑，收割那些急着入场的人。
现在行情到底啥情况
简单说，行情在等一个没法提前埋伏的变量。不是降息，也不是加息，而是资金到底往哪走、宏观风险能不能进一步明朗，还有等大家的情绪都被磨得差不多了，行情才会出现突破。在这之前，行情大概率就是上不去、下不深，专门治那些没耐心的人。
给还在市场里的你一句真心话
要是你最近总感觉手痒想操作，又总觉得哪里不对劲，每次进场都被行情来回打脸，那不是你技术不行。而是这个阶段，根本就不适合情绪化的玩家。真正该做的不是急着选多空站队，而是好好想想：你是打算熬过这个周期，还是只想赌一把情绪？行情天天有，但能熬到行情方向明确的人，可没几个。看明白这一点，你就已经比一半的人强了。

🚨 Bombshell! Tom Lee announces: Bitmine will "never sell" its nearly 4% holding of $ETH ! This effectively locks in a "permanent supply vacuum" worth billions of dollars.

The chairman of the Ethereum treasury company has declared not only a holding close to 4% of the total supply but, more crucially, has made a commitment to "never sell." If these ETH are staked, it is expected to generate over $1 million in net income daily.

💥 Why is this nuclear-level news?
This is far beyond just "whales hoarding." It means that nearly 4% of the circulating ETH supply in the market could be permanently "locked up." This is exacerbating Ethereum's epic "supply shock."

Three major forces shaping the "supply vacuum":

1. Institutional treasury hoarding: Digital asset treasuries like Bitmine have accumulated huge amounts of ETH, intending to hold long-term.
2. ETF massive accumulation: The U.S. spot ETH ETF has already secured about 5.6% of the total supply of ETH.
3. Staking lock-up: Over 30% of ETH is staked, and due to the exit queue mechanism, most liquidity is restricted.

🚀 What does this mean for the market?
